prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with carbohydrate loading for a 42km race in 3 days

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals/snacks
Includes pre-workout, during-workout, and post-workout nutrition with specific timing
Provides high carbohydrate content (60-65% of total calories) appropriate for endurance athlete
Total daily calories align with marathon training requirements (3000-3500 kcal range)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading, including specific timing for pre/during/post-workout nutrition
